hints.title: Multiplicative Ratio Path Search Obstacle
hints.text: Equations represent directed multiplicative relationships between variable nodes. A query evaluates to the cumulative product along a path connecting numerator to denominator. How can traversing these links answer each query?

hints.title: Invertible Edge Weight Product Invariant
hints.text: Treat each equation A / B = val as a pair of directed edges: A to B with multiplier val, and B to A with multiplier 1.0 / val. Finding a path between variables yields their quotient by multiplying edge weights.

hints.title: Graph Traversal Multiplicative Search Procedure
hints.text: Build an adjacency map where each node maps to its neighbors and transition multipliers. For each query, if either variable is missing from the graph, return -1.0. If both variables match, return 1.0. Otherwise, explore outward tracking cumulative product until reaching the target variable. If unreachable, return -1.0.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Building the graph takes O(E); each query performs a BFS/DFS traversal across at most V nodes and E edges.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct algebraic substitution across arbitrary systems of equations without a graph model is complex.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Adjacency hash map stores variables and edge ratios in O(V + E) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Modeling quotient calculations as edge multiplications and reciprocal back-edges.
